caption: The drawing features a single, centrally positioned glass vessel depicted in shades of blue-green. The vessel has a rounded body that tapers inward towards the neck, then flares outward to form a wide-mouthed rim with multiple parallel lines indicating thickness or decoration. The body of the vessel has three decorative, raised, and curvilinear elements on its surface, each symmetrically positioned around the vessel, with additional small protruding features at the ends of each curve. The vessel stands on a thick, circular base that is shaded to suggest depth and three-dimensionality. The background is a plain off-white color with some areas of mild discoloration and faint marks, and there is a faint signature in the lower right corner of the image. No other objects are present in the composition.
title: Glass Vase
